Leading Cybersecurity in the AI Era 

In the AI era, speed is survival. CrowdStrike is leading the charge — redefining cybersecurity to outpace today’s fastest threats. 

  

Fal.Con is the can’t-miss event to learn how to supercharge your SOC and harness the power of AI. Transform into an AI-powered security force that's faster, smarter, and built to win against modern adversaries. 

  

2025 keynote videos

The Epicenter for Outsmarting Modern Threats 

No one knows the adversary better than CrowdStrike, and Fal.Con is the premier destination for the latest trends, tradecraft, and research. Featuring threat briefings, intel sessions, and the just-announced Day Zero Threat Research Summit convening the world’s foremost threat hunters, analysts, and intelligence experts. 

  

  

Agenda

Consolidate with the Leading Platform for Securing the AI Era 

Learn from hundreds of industry leaders driving breakthrough results with CrowdStrike. From SOC transformation to security consolidation to modernizing cloud security, attend for real-world stories, proven strategies, and actionable insights to help security teams consolidate with confidence.
